name: python-tarjan-scc
title: Tarjan Component Walker
blurb: Tarjan's strongly-connected components over small digraphs: the walker's partition equals the shipped reachability oracle's partition on every shipped and seeded corpus, every node lands in exactly one component, and the condensed graph is acyclic under the shipped cycle checker.
default_description: A component walker whose partition is the closure's partition on every small digraph, and whose condensed graph clears the cycle checker.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: two nodes share a component only when each reaches the other
